context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Introspection leaf of the 20-command file-plugin aggregation beneath the centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and registration (init.ts) seam. Unlike file/git siblings (validate-containment → execute → adapt) and bottom-up siblings (inherited context, SHA-256 hash-cache, coverage validation, plan/draft/accept modal lifecycle), it performs no filesystem, git, ripgrep, or Blossom I/O — it terminates the dispatch fan-out as a purely presentational endpoint that surfaces the sibling catalog for CLI/web discoverability.

files.adapter.ts: Dispatch-facing adapter implementing the shared CLI/web file-command contract for this aggregation. Entry point invoked via the parent handleFile fan-out; builds the help subcommand representation from adapter params and delegates content to module.ts, isolating rendering/error handling from definition — mirroring sibling adapters but bypassing workspace-containment validation and side effects.
files.module.ts: Canonical content owner for file-plugin help within the aggregation. Centralizes commandDefinition and usage-line formatting (arguments/options/summaries → strings) as the single source of truth consumed by both adapter.ts for rendering and the plugin registration layer, keeping help synchronized with the 20-subcommand catalog without duplicating metadata.
